title: Visuelles Element / Schwelle variants
slide_intent: Simplify a repeated structure at small sizes so its gaps remain distinct.
strategic_value: A dedicated compact variant can preserve recognition when DB has little space.
demonstration: The section explains standard and S variants and compares their bar counts in two labeled specimens.
practical_value: Use the standard version normally and choose S when space is narrow or height falls below 32 px digitally or 6 mm in print.

content_islands.name: Variant guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation and small-size conditions above the specimens.

content_islands.name: Specimen pair
content_islands.spec: Compare Standardschwelle and S-Variante side by side.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says fewer elements preserve proportions and character at small sizes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The S variant applies below 32 px digital height or 6 mm print height, and in constrained settings where the standard would require compression.
reference_purposes.Application: The side-by-side pair identifies which supplied variant to select.

ingredient.name: Schwelle S variant
ingredient.role: Keep bar gaps distinct in compact applications.
ingredient.application: Prefer the standard; use S for narrow placements and below 32 px digital or 6 mm print height.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. The source also cites headline connections as constrained applications.
